method: Each roster address was submitted with street, city, state PA and ZIP. Where that returned nothing, the request was retried with street, state and ZIP, then street, city and state. The importer accepts a result only when one candidate names the same house number and street; a match found without the city or ZIP is not accepted.
limitations: Census geocoding places an address along a street segment. The point is approximate, not the storefront, and supports only straight-line distance sorting. County comes from the Census county layer for the matched point.
